'''''Watalappam''''' is a Sri Lankan steamed coconut [[Cookbook:Custard|custard]].

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] thick [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] (or [[Cookbook:Jaggery|jaggery]])	
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of ground [[Cookbook:Cardamom|cardamom]] (optional)
* 3 [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]] (optional)	
* 12 [[Cookbook:Cashew|cashews]]

==Procedure==
#Beat the eggs in a [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]]. Add the milk, brown sugar, cardamom, and cloves to the beaten eggs. Mix well.
#Transfer the mixture to a pot and [[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] for 20 minutes. Add the cashews.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* One can also vary or enhance the aroma and flavour by adding thick [[Cookbook:Pandan|pandan]] juice or [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] pod gratings.
* Alternatively, the mixture can be poured into multiple small aluminum baking foils and then steamed for about 5–10 minutes.
